page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9i.2xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor running at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The instance is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external block storage volumes. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio position this instance as a resource-dense option for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local storage.

Given its hardware profile, the ecs.c9i.2xlarge is suited for compute-intensive tasks such as batch processing, web serving, front-end servers, and application servers. The dedicated Intel Xeon cores make it appropriate for workloads requiring consistent CPU performance without the risk of resource contention.
